job.title: Clinical Services Manager, Diabetes (Sydney)
job.description:
What’s in it for you?

· Join a global diabetes technology company at the forefront of insulin delivery
· Competitive salary package with car allowance, super and a substantial performance-based bonus
· Full Bupa private health insurance for you and your entire family!
· Novated leasing available
· Work with innovative diabetes technology and make a direct impact on patients living with diabetes

The Company

A global medical technology company specialising in diabetes is looking for a Clinical Educator to join their Australia team.

The business is focused on improving the way people living with diabetes manage their condition through innovative insulin delivery technology. This role will work closely with the Territory Management team, supporting patients and healthcare professionals across North and Western Sydney.

The Role

Territory: North & Western Sydney

This is a clinical education-focused role based in Sydney, covering North and Western Sydney and working across hospitals, diabetes centres and other healthcare settings throughout the territory.

You’ll work with patients from the start of their journey, providing ongoing clinical education and nurture through regular check-ins at different stages. You’ll educate patients, families, care teams and healthcare professionals. You will work closely alongside an experienced Territory Management team on education initiatives and focus on building strong relationships with endocrinologists, dieticians, nurse educators and other healthcare professionals across the diabetes community.

Key responsibilities include:

· Support patients through pump starts and onboarding
· Educate patients, their families and care teams and diabetes educators on the use of the technology
· Provide ongoing clinical support throughout the patient journey
· Deliver education sessions and in-services for healthcare professionals
· Run lunch & learn sessions and other education activities
· Work closely with the NSW Territory Managers to support customers and patient outcomes
· Build strong relationships with dieticians, endocrinologists, nurse educators and other healthcare professionals
· Conduct follow-up and nurture calls with patients as required
· Maintain accurate patient and activity records

About you

This role would suit a Credentialled Diabetes Educator, Registered Nurse or dietician with a strong clinical background and a genuine interest in diabetes.

  • Clinical healthcare background, ideally with experience in diabetes and/or diabetes technology
  • Credentialled Diabetes Educator (CDE) qualification highly regarded
  • Confidence providing education, training and support to patients, families and
  • healthcare professionals
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage with a range of clinical stakeholders
  • An adaptable approach and willingness to learn new technology, products and clinical concepts
  • Confidence working independently across a large geographical territory
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage CRM, reporting and administrative requirements
  • The ability to work collaboratively alongside a sales team, while maintaining a strong focus on the clinical and educational aspects of the role
  • Confidence communicating with and appropriately challenging stakeholders when required
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary healthcare teams
  • A full Australian driver’s licence and access to a car

If this role aligns with your experience and interests, please don’t hesitate to contact Alexandra Falconer at OneMD for further information.

If this isn’t quite the right opportunity but you’re open to exploring the market, feel free to reach out to the OneMD team for a confidential discussion about other opportunities that may be a better fit.

job.title: Product Manager, Cardiology (Sydney)
job.description:
What's in it for you?

  • Join one of the largest providers of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions globally
  • Hybrid working – 2 days in office, 3 from home
  • Birthday leave and volunteer leave
  • Additional annual leave purchase scheme
  • Private health care discount with Bupa
  • Novated leasing
  • Discounted gym membership

The Company

An international medical device company who operate over 100 countries with a portfolio spanning Surgical Solutions, Front Line Care and Laboratory & Diagnostics, is looking for a Product Manager to join their Sydney team.

The business has a strong presence across ANZ and is looking for someone to take ownership of a well-established cardiac portfolio with a strong position in the Australian market. You’ll work closely with the vascular sales team and global marketing teams to shape the portfolio strategy and drive continued growth across ANZ.

The Role

Portfolio: Cardiac and interventional consumables

This is a hands-on Product Manager role with responsibility for the full portfolio across ANZ.
You’ll have ownership across portfolio including strategy, budgeting, forecasting, P&L responsibility, product lifecycle and execution and working closely with the sales team to identify opportunities and deliver against growth targets.

This is a strategic marketing role suited to someone who enjoys owning the full end-to-end process and taking responsibility for the performance and growth of an established product portfolio.

Key responsibilities include:

· Develop and execute the portfolio strategy across ANZ
· Manage the product lifecycle and downstream marketing activities
· Own portfolio budgeting, forecasting and P&L
· Develop and execute commercial and marketing plans
· Monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer insights
· Support product launches and portfolio growth initiatives
· Work closely with the sales team to develop tools, resources and strategies that support commercial performance
· Manage portfolio spend and deliver against growth targets
· Collaborate closely with US-based marketing teams and global stakeholders
· Travel as and when required to assist both internal and external stakeholders

About you

This role would suit a Product Manager, Associate Product Manager or sales representative with experience in the medical device industry. Candidates with strong cath lab, vascular or cardiac experience whether from a marketing or commercial background will be highly regarded and considered highly advantageous.

  • Strong experience in product management, downstream marketing and/or commercial marketing
  • Experience developing product positioning, value propositions, and customer-facing marketing materials.
  • Ability to develop and execute portfolio strategies and marketing plans
  • Comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of a product or portfolio
  • Strong understanding of customer needs and the ability to translate these into commercial strategies
  • Comfortable working closely with sales and field-based teams
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Willingness to travel nationally as required
  • Comfortable working US hours when required to collaborate with the global team


If this role aligns with your experience and interests, apply now!

If this isn’t quite the right opportunity but you’re open to exploring the market, feel free to reach out to the OneMD team for a confidential discussion about other opportunities that may be a better fit.

job.title: Service Administration Assistant - NSW
job.description:
What's in it for you?


  • Join a growing global MedTech company with a genuinely meaningful purpose

  • A varied coordination and administration role with opportunities to grow and specialise

  • Bring your Service Administration or Scheduling experience into the MedTech industry - industry experience is not essential

  • Or, if you're a recent Health Science graduate, build valuable commercial and administrative experience in a fast-growing healthcare environment

Our client is a global MedTech company that has been developing and manufacturing innovative medical technology products for more than 35 years.

Based at their new office in Lane Cove West, you'll provide administrative and coordination support across a growing team spanning Operations, Service, Finance, Sales and Marketing.

The Role

This is a permanent, full-time, office-based role offering plenty of variety and the opportunity to build a long-term career within a growing MedTech business.

We're open to candidates from a range of backgrounds. You might be an experienced Service Administrator, Service Coordinator or Scheduler looking to transfer your skills from industries such as engineering, facilities, construction, HVAC, automotive or other field-service environments.

Alternatively, you may be a recent Health Science graduate with some customer service or administration experience who is looking to take your first step into the MedTech industry.

The role will provide broad administrative support across the business, with the opportunity to develop exposure and specialisation in key areas.

Your duties will include:


  • Provide general administrative support to management and teams across the business

  • Coordinate meetings, appointments, events and team travel

  • Coordinate service bookings and maintain accurate service records and documentation

  • Liaise with customers and internal teams to support effective service delivery

  • Assist with processing invoices and purchase orders

  • Prepare quotes and sales-related resources

  • Maintain databases, contact lists and mailing lists

  • Assist with social media updates and other marketing activities

  • Support the Finance, Operations, Service, RAQA, Sales and Marketing teams with day-to-day administration

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive and enjoys keeping things moving. You may come from one of two backgrounds:

Service Administration / Scheduling


  • Experience in Service Administration, Service Coordination or Scheduling

  • Experience in a field-service or blue-collar environment such as engineering, facilities, construction, HVAC, automotive or similar would be highly regarded

  • Confident coordinating multiple jobs, bookings, customers and internal stakeholders

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep accurate records

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change

Health Science Graduate / Early Career


  • A recent degree in Health Science, Biomedical Science, Medical Science or a related discipline would be highly regarded

  • Some customer service, administration or coordination experience

  • A genuine interest in healthcare and Medical Technology

  • Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn the commercial side of the MedTech industry

For either background, you'll also bring:


  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong organisational and time-management skills

  • A high level of attention to detail

  • A proactive, can-do approach and willingness to take ownership

  • The ability to work collaboratively while managing your own responsibilities

  • A genuine interest in building a career in the MedTech industry

  • The ability to work on site 5 days per week initially, with potential for some hybrid flexibility in the medium to long term

If you're looking for a role where you can use your existing coordination skills or build your career in MedTech, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Reimbursement Specialist (Diabetes) - NSW, 12-month Contract

job.title: State Sales Manager - Joint Replacement - (Adelaide)
job.description:
State Sales Manager – Orthopaedics - Adelaide

An outstanding opportunity has become available to join a globally recognised orthopaedic organisation as State Sales Manager, leading the South Australian business.

This is far more than a sales management position.

It's an opportunity to develop people, influence strategy, strengthen customer partnerships, and play a key role in the continued growth of a market-leading orthopaedic portfolio.

Whether you're already leading a successful sales team or you're a high-performing Senior Territory Manager or Business Development Manager ready to step into leadership, this role offers the platform to make a genuine impact.

 

About the Role

Reporting to the National Sales Director, you'll be responsible for leading the commercial strategy across South Australia while coaching and developing a high-performing team of Product Specialists.

Success in this role isn't simply measured by revenue growth. It's about creating a culture of accountability, developing future leaders, strengthening key customer relationships, and ensuring your team has the tools, confidence, and capability to consistently deliver exceptional results.

Working closely with Marketing, Clinical Education and the broader leadership team, you'll help shape both regional execution and national strategy.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Lead Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute the regional sales strategy to achieve and exceed business objectives
  • Drive sustainable sales growth and increase market share across Adelaide
  • Analyse sales performance, customer insights and market trends to identify new opportunities
  • Manage regional budgets and business performance
  • Translate national strategies into successful regional execution

 

Develop High Performing People

  • Lead, coach and mentor a team of Product Specialists
  • Conduct regular field coaching and joint customer visits
  • Develop individual capability through structured development plans
  • Foster a positive, collaborative and high-performance culture
  • Recruit, develop and retain top talent

 

Build Strategic Customer Relationships

  • Support your team in developing meaningful partnerships with surgeons, hospital executives and procurement teams
  • Guide strategic account planning across key hospitals
  • Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities that improve clinical and commercial outcomes

 

Collaborate Across the Business

  • Work closely with Marketing, Clinical Education and National Leadership to deliver business objectives
  • Contribute to business planning and strategic initiatives
  • Champion best practice and continuous improvement across the wider sales organisation

 

About You

You'll be an inspiring leader with a passion for developing people and driving commercial success.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Orthopaedic medical device sales experience
  • Previous leadership experience or a proven track record as a Senior Territory Manager or Business Development Manager ready to step into management
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience developing strategic account plans
  • Excellent coaching, mentoring and people development skills
  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • A collaborative leadership style with a genuine passion for helping others succeed
  • Degree qualified in Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline (preferred)

 

Why Join?

  • Join a globally recognised leader in orthopaedic medical technology
  • Lead an established, high-performing team with significant growth opportunities
  • Work alongside an experienced and supportive national leadership team
  • Influence strategy while remaining closely connected to customers and your team
  • Access ongoing leadership development and long-term career progression
  • Competitive salary package, performance incentives, vehicle allowance and comprehensive employee benefits

 

Who This Role Would Suit

This opportunity is ideal for:

  • A current State or Regional Sales Manager looking to join a global market leader.
  • A high-performing Senior Territory Manager or Business Development Manager who has demonstrated leadership capability and is ready to take the next step.
  • A people-first sales leader who enjoys coaching, mentoring and building high-performing teams as much as delivering commercial results.

 

If you're looking for an opportunity to lead from the front, develop exceptional people, and influence the future growth of a leading orthopaedic business, it would be great to connect with you. jonathan.gertler@onemd.com.au / 0406 423 734

job.title: Territory Manager - Joint Replacement - Melbourne
job.description:
Territory Sales Manager – Orthopaedics - Melbourne

 

Join a Specialist Orthopaedic Manufacturer with an Outstanding Clinical Reputation

An exciting opportunity has become available to join a highly respected orthopaedic manufacturer that has built its reputation on clinical excellence rather than portfolio size.

 

With a focused range of orthopaedic implant solutions supported by outstanding long-term clinical data, this business has earned the trust of surgeons by consistently delivering quality, innovation, and exceptional patient outcomes.

 

As the business continues to grow across Australia, they are seeking an experienced Territory Sales Manager to drive market expansion, strengthen surgeon relationships, and support the continued adoption of their specialist orthopaedic portfolio.

 

About the Role

Reporting into the Sales Director, you'll take ownership of your territory, driving commercial growth through strategic account management, business development, and outstanding clinical support.

Working closely with a Business Development Manager, you'll create a unified approach to customer engagement while providing hands-on operating theatre support and delivering exceptional service to surgeons and hospital stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced orthopaedic sales professional who enjoys building long-term partnerships and representing products backed by outstanding clinical evidence.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Achieve and exceed territory sales and growth objectives
  • Develop new business opportunities while growing existing surgeon relationships
  • Increase utilisation of a specialist orthopaedic implant portfolio
  • Deliver high-quality in-theatre clinical support and product expertise
  • Build trusted relationships with surgeons, theatre staff, procurement teams, and hospital executives
  • Work collaboratively with Business Development, Clinical Education, Operations, and Customer Service teams
  • Maintain accurate CRM activity, forecasting, and pipeline management
  • Deliver educational presentations and product training to healthcare professionals
  • Monitor market activity and provide commercial insights to support business strategy

 

About You

You'll be an ambitious and commercially driven medical device professional who enjoys working closely with surgeons and thrives in a theatre-based environment.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Proven success in orthopaedic or medical device sales
  • Experience managing and growing a sales territory
  • Strong understanding of orthopaedic implant systems and surgical procedures
  • Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • A proactive, organised, and accountable approach to territory management
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage pipeline and forecasting
  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Science, Healthcare, or a related discipline

Existing relationships within the Australian orthopaedic market will be highly regarded.

 

Why Join?

  • Represent a specialist orthopaedic manufacturer renowned for exceptional clinical outcomes
  • Sell products supported by excellent long-term clinical evidence and surgeon confidence
  • Join a growing organisation where your contribution has genuine impact
  • Work within an agile business that values collaboration, innovation, and customer partnerships
  • Build lasting relationships with leading orthopaedic surgeons across your territory
  • Competitive salary package with performance incentives, vehicle allowance, and career development opportunities

 

This Opportunity Is Ideal For

  • An experienced Orthopaedic Territory Manager looking for greater ownership and autonomy.
  • A high-performing medical device sales professional wanting to represent a focused, premium portfolio rather than a broad product range.
  • Someone who values quality, clinical credibility, and building long-term surgeon partnerships over transactional selling.

 

If you're passionate about orthopaedics and want to represent products that genuinely make a difference to patient outcomes, please reach out to Jonathan Gertler 0406 423 734
